text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor b-u-i-l-t a s-h-r-i-k-e-l-y r-o-m-a-n-c-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a to a-p-p-r-o-a-c-h t-a-r-g-e-t-s o-v-e-r w-e-e-k-s, u-s-i-n-g a v-i-e-w-e-d i-m-a-g-e g-a-l-l-e-r-y a-n-d a s-h-a-r-e-d f-r-i-e-n-d l-i-s-t as m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l-s, which l-e-f-t a c-h-a-r-a-c-t-e-r b-i-o a-n-d s-t-a-r-t-e-r m-e-s-s-a-g-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e as the t-r-a-c-e, and the k-n-o-w-n v-i-c-t-i-m n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
2) the actor s-t-a-g-g-e-r-e-d t-r-u-s-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s a-c-r-o-s-s c-h-a-t t-h-r-e-a-d-s to n-o-r-m-a-l-i-z-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s, r-e-l-y-i-n-g on p-r-e-s-e-t e-m-p-a-t-h-y r-e-p-l-i-e-s and a s-l-o-w b-u-r-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e, which l-e-f-t a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p c-h-a-i-n as the t-r-a-c-e, and the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y r-a-t-e a-l-e-r-t was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
3) the actor i-n-t-r-o-d-u-c-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y s-t-o-r-i-e-s to t-r-i-g-g-e-r p-a-y-m-e-n-t s-a-p-s, u-s-i-n-g f-a-k-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t i-m-a-g-e-s and a t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y r-e-c-e-i-p-i-e-n-t, which l-e-f-t a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-t in the m-e-s-s-a-g-e l-o-g as the t-r-a-c-e, and the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
4) the actor r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-u-l-e-s v-i-a s-e-p-a-r-a-t-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s to m-o-v-e f-u-n-d-s, o-f-f-e-r-i-n-g a s-m-a-l-l r-e-t-u-r-n f-o-r e-a-c-h h-o-p, which l-e-f-t a c-o-m-m-o-n t-o-k-e-n i-n r-e-c-r-u-i-t-m-e-n-t c-h-a-t-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the f-r-i-e-n-d-o-f-f-r-i-e-n-d v-e-t-t-i-n-g was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
5) the actor i-s-s-u-e-d g-e-n-e-r-i-c w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s d-i-s-c-o-u-r-a-g-i-n-g v-i-c-t-i-m s-h-a-r-i-n-g of d-e-t-a-i-l-s, r-e-l-y-i-n-g on f-l-a-t-t-e-r and g-u-i-l-t a-p-p-e-a-l s, which l-e-f-t a r-e-p-e-a-t-e-d p-h-r-a-s-e in m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e t-h-r-e-a-d-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the c-r-o-s-s r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
